parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Returns payments with `reference` values exactly matching your specified value.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Returns payments with matching `email` values. You can send full or partial email addresses. `email` is the paying user’s email address.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Returns payments in a matching `state`. `state` reflects where a payment is in the [payment status lifecycle](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/api_reference/#payment-status-lifecycle).

parameters.name: card_brand
parameters.description: Returns payments paid with a particular card brand.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Returns payments created on or after the `from_date`. Date and time must be coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and ISO 8601 format to second-level accuracy - `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Returns payments created before the `to_date`. Date and time must be coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and ISO 8601 format to second-level accuracy - `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Returns a [specific page of results](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/api_reference/#pagination). Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: display_size
parameters.description: The number of payments returned [per results page](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/api_reference/#pagination). Defaults to `500`. Maximum value is `500`.

parameters.name: cardholder_name
parameters.description: Returns payments paid with cards under this cardholder name.

parameters.name: first_digits_card_number
parameters.description: Returns payments paid by cards beginning with the `first_digits_card_number` value. `first_digits_card_number` value must be 6 digits.

parameters.name: last_digits_card_number
parameters.description: Returns payments paid by cards ending with the `last_digits_card_number` value. `last_digits_card_number` value must be 4 digits.

parameters.name: from_settled_date
parameters.description: Returns payments settled on or after the `from_settled_date` value. You can only search by settled date if your payment service provider is Stripe. Date must be in ISO 8601 format to date-level accuracy - `YYYY-MM-DD`. Payments are settled when your payment service provider sends funds to your bank account.

parameters.name: to_settled_date
parameters.description: Returns payments settled before the `to_settled_date` value. You can only search by settled date if your payment service provider is Stripe. Date must be in ISO 8601 format to date-level accuracy - `YYYY-MM-DD`. Payments are settled when your payment service provider sends funds to your bank account.

parameters.name: agreement_id
parameters.description: Returns payments that were authorised using the agreement with this `agreement_id`. Must be an exact match.
